description: A single character doing a wave gesture, 3s loop at 30fps (90 frames), 512x512.
notes: Colors are matched by the 'nm' (name) field on the shape's fill item, not by string token replacement — a builder script should parse the Lottie JSON and rewrite the matching fill's 'c.k' array. This keeps the source file valid, renderable Lottie JSON on its own.
